payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data, including manual inspections, perplexity measurements, and similarity scores.

claims.text: The quality of the data is empirically evaluated through manual inspections of translations, measuring perplexity using a language model, and calculating similarity scores between transcripts and translations.
Quality checks include ensuring that translations have a high ratio of English characters and that there is minimal overlap between training and test sets.
The evaluation metrics used include BLEU scores for machine translation and word error rates for automatic speech recognition.
